textEquivalent:
Documentary reference · original paraphrase

At Berea Falls, erosion of shale beneath sandstone undermines the sandstone, which can then break away. Shale is the foundation material in this reference. This is a conceptual account of cause and effect, not a measured rock section or a transcription of a sign.

Conceptual comparison: sandstone lies above shale. Erosion in the shale removes support beneath the sandstone; unsupported sandstone can break away. No thickness, age or exact local geometry is represented.

Private packing investigation · fictional controlled tests. The same cradle and outer packing were used in each test. Compare every observation, not just whether something moved. Natural erosion is a comparison for loss of support; the controlled packing tests supply the case evidence.
